# Public metadata fixtures

These adapted fixtures retain factual provider IDs, publication titles, dates,
issue labels and type observations needed by contract tests. Descriptive prose
has been replaced with original synthetic text retaining classification terms.
They are not verbatim live-provider responses. No comic pages, cover images,
credentials, cookies or private user data are included. Tests do not contact
providers or download artwork. Filenames remain for test compatibility.

The retained GCD data is attributed to the Grand Comics Database and its
contributors, under **CC BY-SA 4.0**, not relicensed as GPL. Per-file acquisition
records identify source API URLs and the adaptations. The source-field subset,
synthetic description replacement and removal of cover URLs are modifications.
Retained factual notes/credits remain under those same terms.

Source: https://www.comics.org/ — license:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ ; full license is included in
`licenses/GCD-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt` at repository root. No endorsement is implied.
New fixtures must be reproducible offline and retain source attribution/license.
Do not add copyrighted cover/page images or credentials.
